```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Tail and input-pair headroom are violated at Vcm=0.9 V (tail triode, vo1 pulled to 0.16 V so the CS stage is off). Topology is salvageable: lower tail Vdsat with higher gm/Id, shorter input L to lower Vth, and faster inverter drive. Static current is held near the previous level to stay under the 39 uW limit."}
```

```python
VDD = 1.8
L_BIAS = 0.5   # reference / tail mirror length [um]

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (20.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # nfet pair and CS gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_in":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # diff pair length [um]
    "gmid_ld":   (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # pfet load / CS-load gm/Id
    "L_ld":      (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),      # load and CS length [um]
    "gmid_bias": (16.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # reference and tail mirror gm/Id (high = low Vdsat tail)
    "K_tail":    (0.8, 0.6, 1.2),        # tail current = K_tail * iref
    "k_cs":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # CS-stage current = k_cs * (tail/2)
    "gmid_inv":  (5.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # inverter gm/Id (drive strength)
    "L_inv":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # inverter length [um]
    "I_inv":     (110e-6, 25e-6, 120e-6),# inverter transient drive current (not static)
    "r_p":       (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # pfet/nfet inverter current ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vod = spec["vod"]

    # static current budget: iref + tail + CS load
    I_tail = p["K_tail"] * iref
    I1 = I_tail / 2.0
    I_cs = p["k_cs"] * I1
    I_inv = p["I_inv"]

    # sizing from design intent (equal gm/Id and L so mirrors track)
    ref  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bias"], L_BIAS, iref, vds=0.6)
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bias"], L_BIAS, I_tail, vds=0.15)
    m1   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1, vds=0.4)    # vinp side (diode side)
    m2   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1, vds=0.4)    # vinn -> vo1
    m3   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I1, vds=0.5)    # diode load
    m4   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I1, vds=0.5)    # mirror load -> vo1
    m5   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_ld"], I_cs, vds=0.5)  # CS stage, gate = vo1
    m6   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I_cs, vds=0.5)  # CS load, gate = d1
    m7   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], I_inv, vds=0.9)
    m8   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["r_p"] * I_inv, vds=0.9)

    # netlist
    # vinp on M1 (diode side) gives vo1 rising with vinp (non-inverting).
    # CS stage inverts (vo2), CMOS inverter inverts again, so vout is HIGH when vinp > vinn.
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mref",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)
    n.dev("Mtail", "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)
    n.dev("M1",    "d1",    "vinp",  "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2",    "vo1",   "vinn",  "tail", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3",    "d1",    "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m3)   # diode load
    n.dev("M4",    "vo1",   "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m4)   # mirror load
    n.dev("M5",    "vo2",   "vo1",   "vss", "vss", m5)   # CS amplifier
    n.dev("M6",    "vo2",   "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m6)   # CS load (mirror of M3)
    n.dev("M7",    "vout",  "vo2",   "vss", "vss", m7)   # output inverter
    n.dev("M8",    "vout",  "vo2",   "vdd", "vdd", m8)

    # first-order predictions
    gds1 = m2.gds + m4.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / gds1
    tau1 = (m2.cdd + m4.cdd + m5.cgg) / gds1

    gds2 = m5.gds + m6.gds
    A2 = m5.gm / gds2
    tau2 = (m5.cdd + m6.cdd + m7.cgg + m8.cgg) / gds2

    A3 = (m7.gm + m8.gm) / (m7.gds + m8.gds)

    t1 = tau1 * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (vod * A1), 1.0))
    t2 = tau2 * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (vod * A1 * A2), 1.0))
    t3 = cl * (VDD / 2) / I_inv
    tpd_ns = (t1 + t2 + t3) * 1e9

    # static power: reference + tail + CS load (inverter draws no static current)
    P_uW = VDD * (iref + I_tail + I_cs) * 1e6

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd_ns,
        "power": P_uW,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "voh_rel": 0.99,
        "vol_rel": 0.01,
        "gain_db": db(A1 * A2 * A3),
    }
```
